description: research-ledger: context intake, failure recall and capture. Silent outside a ledger and when there is nothing to add.

hooks.command: if command -v ledger >/dev/null 2>&1; then ledger hook session-start; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"research-ledger: the plugin is installed but the `ledger` command is not on PATH, so its hooks are off. Tell the user and offer /research-ledger:onboard to install it."}}'; fi
command -v ledger >/dev/null 2>&1 && ledger hook user-prompt || true
command -v ledger >/dev/null 2>&1 && ledger hook pre-bash || true
command -v ledger >/dev/null 2>&1 && ledger hook tool-failure || true
